description: The B017 UX/operational regression manifest: every conformance check mapped to the surface that OWNS the behavior it asserts. The TL uses this at every future intake — a change to a listed surface re-runs the mapped checks.

legend.status: pass = green at the recorded run; known-defect = the check encodes a discovered defect as a characterization tripwire (fails the moment the defect is fixed, forcing the strict expectation); env-dependent = requires the host to provide Playwright + Chromium (self-skips otherwise).
legend.layers: composition = in-process composition + static markup (always runs); served = HTTP against the runner-booted next start; browser = real headless Chromium measurement.

checks.title: Shell renders a nav link for every core route; nav hrefs are real routes (no orphan affordances)
First-run landing renders with exactly ONE primary action into /cases
Loading/error/not-found render truthful, actionable design-system states
Every core and demo route answers 200 with its route marker; unknown routes answer 404 with the standard empty state; session surfaces fail closed (denied) without a session
Every rendered truth badge is inside the closed vocabulary (ui-platform StateKind + pending/unknown); no invented badges
The cockpit shows DISTINCT truth kinds with DISTINCT treatments — simulation/verified/certification/demo never collapse
The evaluation surface renders the three-way distinction note verbatim + the truth-class legend; evaluation/verified/certification each marked
The audit stream renders as evidence with the append-only note; the capacity board renders the fail-closed guarantee verbatim
Demo data never renders without its Demo badge (B006 labelling survives every screen)
checks.ownerSurface: apps/web/src/** demo banner/badge usage (B006 labelling contract)

checks.title: The B006 product-truth label vocabulary maps onto closed rendered kinds (no orphan labels)
The research surface renders the composition-scope banner (never bare-model rankings)
Fail-closed gates: every session surface gates an unauthenticated visitor (no anonymous data surface)
Honest empty states: authenticated sessions over an EMPTY control plane render truthful empties with actionable next steps (start a case, nothing fabricated, no-data SLOs never green)
No raw JSON rendering on any demo or core page (entity-aware scan; the labelled corpus-hash digest display is the single documented exception, count-bounded to one per page)
No horizontal overflow at 390x844 and 1280x800 (real headless Chromium measurement, per-element offender naming)
checks.finding: UX-VIEWPORT-01 (mobile-only): every demo-surface data table overflows 390px because its role=region scroll wrapper class never sets overflow-x: auto — /demo/bodies (741px), /demo/research (875px), /demo/evaluation (840px), /demo/operations (684px), /demo/operations/jobs (826px), /demo/operations/capacity (472px), plus the /demo/cases demo-banner corpus-hash code line (394px). All pages are clean at 1280x800. Encoded as characterization tripwires: the battery asserts the defect's presence and FAILS when a surface is fixed, forcing the strict expectation. Proposed root fix (TL-owned surfaces): overflow-x: auto on the table scroll-region classes in packages/ui-platform/src/styles/components.css + overflow-wrap: anywhere on the demo-banner hash code (or render the 8-char FNV hash summary).

checks.title: Static overflow-safety analysis: minmax(0,1fr) shell grids, no fixed CSS width > 390px, three breakpoints, reduced-motion
Responsive shell switches zones (bottom-nav at 390, rail at 1280); keyboard reaches real interactive elements
Capacity panel shows the free-tier state: all four closed FT2.0 postures with visible ceilings, worst-of overall, exhaustion policy rendered as data

Fail-closed exhaustion: EXHAUSTED/DISABLED render as REFUSAL (typed reasons, fail closed, no upgrade/billing escape anywhere); assertCapacityUsable throws the typed error; unknown ceilings render as unknown, never unlimited
checks.ownerSurface: packages/persistence/src/capacity.ts (B002 fail-closed guard) + apps/web/src/operations capacity views (B014)

checks.title: The audit stream records lifecycle hops: verified append-only A034 chain (authorization decisions, tenant-scope denials) + job lifecycle transition histories with monotone sequences

Full Capability Case lifecycle walk with state-machine legality at every hop, append-only history, Task/Environment hops, four-role projection equality after every hop; typed illegal-transition rejections; read-path story walk Task->Trajectory->Evaluation->Verification->Certification->Release; reset restores the identical corpus hash

Role-switch simulation: the SAME canonical case projects through Owner/Expert/Builder/Researcher at the B003 contract, the app surfaces and the rendered markup — identity/tenancy preserved, only the projection changes; truthful not-granted denial
Determinism: frozen corpus hash constant, byte-identical double resolution + double render across 13 demo surfaces, fixed narrative read stamps, B016 seed parity through the real seed command
checks.ownerSurface: packages/demo (B006 corpus/store) + scripts/product/seed.mjs (B016) + apps/web demo compositions

checks.title: Served-app walk: full lifecycle through the REAL origin-checked form POSTs with the 303 redirect contract; foreign Origin 403; typed flowError redirects; /demo/reset semantics
checks.ownerSurface: apps/web/src/app/demo/** route handlers + apps/web/src/capability/flow-actions.ts (B006/B008 form-post contract)

notes: The batteries are NOT pnpm workspace projects (tests/* is outside the workspace globs — the tests/security and tests/epoch-e2e precedent, kept because a root-manifest edit is forbidden for B017). Run them through their self-contained runners: node tests/product-e2e/run.mjs and node tests/ux/run.mjs (both drive apps/web's vitest with --root).

The browser layer needs Playwright + Chromium on the host (ARENA_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE or the global npm prefix). Without it the browser checks self-skip and the static overflow analysis still runs; the runner prints which layer ran.

UX-VIEWPORT-01 is the only known-defect row: the defects live on forbidden surfaces (packages/ui-platform CSS + apps/web table markup), so B017 records them as tripwires and proposes the root fix for TL intake rather than editing the surfaces.
